'''Moss chips''' were a crispy snack [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="tc" /> During the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], they were popular in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|II|335|moss chips}}</ref> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The section of ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'' where [[Moss/Legends|moss]] chips appear takes place 548 [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. As ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that battle to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' establishes that one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] contained 368 days, the section must take place around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> [[Moss/Legends|moss]] chips were eaten by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Niner Skirata]] while he was visiting the Human Republic agent [[Besany Wennen]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="tc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moss chips first appeared in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'' novel series. At one point in the novel, it is stated that the chips were served on a plate; however, a separate sentence maintains that they were served in a bowl.<ref name="tc" /> This article avoids assuming which dish they were served in.
